digest.component_or_area: backend-neutrality test and Jira-family adapter boundary
propositions: The neutrality sweep exemption for inbound_fields.py must be rewritten to state its permanent reason: the root location allows both Jira adapters and root-core consumers to share one mapper without violating the J7 sibling-adapter seal.
Data Center backend genuinely delegates to the same inbound_fields mapper as Cloud, so relocating the module to adapters/jira/ would re-open the sealed sibling-adapter edge.
Moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ violates the mirror rule because root-core importers (inbound_differ.py and peer_state.py) cannot consume that layer.
The module's residency at the package root is a deliberate architectural choice to preserve both the J7 seal and the single shared mapper, not temporary debt to be cleared.
Production code, imports, and gate behavior remain unchanged; only test comments and diagnostics require rewriting to explain the durable constraint.
